author: DanTheFox
text: Hi IF, can i ask what kind of things the course will contain? How will it differ to the academy? thanks

author: Ifmyante
text:
It's very simple stuff.

One module will be step by step instructions on trading the Quasimodo and Diamond

Another will be on trading Compression

Both of these will have exact instructions on money management, entry, stop and target placement

Another one in development is trading psychology.

Each will be completed in one day, but will need to be re-studied in
one's own time, many dozens of times (instinct doesn't come from being
told something once).

I think (at least, I sincerely hope!) that anybody who's meant to be a
trader will be able to make good profits from these courses.

Oh. How does it differ from the Academy?

Well,where the academy teaches a complete understanding of price, these
courses will just be simple treading systems which need an awful lot
less understanding
